_comment: F67 — the vetted non-custodial wallet list shown at onboarding Step 1. Each wallet is self-custodial (the member holds their own keys/seed phrase; no wallet here holds funds on the member's behalf). Reviewed each equinox — links, store IDs, and the set of wallets are re-checked twice a year (around 20 March and 22 September) and any wallet that has turned custodial, unmaintained, or hostile to Solana is removed. Order here is NOT the display order: WalletChooser shuffles uniformly on every load so no wallet holds a permanent first position (Tradition T6 — no endorsements).

wallets.name: Solflare
wallets.note: Solana-native; extension, mobile, and hardware-wallet support.

wallets.name: Glow
wallets.note: Solana wallet; iOS and Android apps + browser extension.

_browseComment: A wallet carries `browse` ONLY if it publishes a documented universal link that opens an arbitrary URL inside its own in-app browser. That is a factual property of the wallet, not a judgement about it: MobileWalletNotice can only offer wallets it can actually deep-link into, and it shuffles the ones it can (T6 — no endorsements) so none holds a permanent first position. A wallet with no `browse` is absent from that banner and present everywhere else. Adding one later needs a data line here, not a code change — and the URL must contain {url} and {ref} placeholders, both percent-encoded at build time so a non-default port survives.
